triage_answers.decision: W3-001: the doubt bears on seam weighing, not typing. It concerns the interior rivals at 8:3/8:4 (a bare resumptive peri, D1) and 8:6/8:7, plus the chapter cap. The outer seams are worded (the 8:1 peri de; the 8:13 resolve against 9:1). W3-002: the doubt bears mainly on typing, example against defence. Seam doubt follows only if the defence reading is taken, giving a 9:2/9:3 seam or a 9:1-9:23 merge. On the RP text both the 9:1 and the 9:15 turns are worded. W3-003: the doubt bears on both. The defence reading would retype the row and remove the 9:15 seam, and the close rests on the change of addressee at 9:24. W3-004: the doubt bears on the seam itself. Across 9:23/9:24, the summary Τοῦτο δὲ ποιῶ διὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον (rp:1Cor.9.23) closes, and Οὕτως τρέχετε (rp:1Cor.9.24) addresses the readers. But Ἐγὼ τοίνυν οὕτως τρέχω (rp:1Cor.9.26) returns to Paul's first-person example, so this merge is the stronger of the two. Across 9:27/10:1, the RP disclosure formula with a vocative, Οὐ θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί (rp:1Cor.10.1), is row-level (D2, grade B). The link back is thematic: the all/most pattern of 9:24 and 10:1-10:5 and the warning at 9:27. SBLGNT γὰρ is a variant site only. I would draw neither merge and would keep W3-004 at medium_low; the doubt falls more on 9:23/9:24 than on 9:27/10:1.
